notes:
The ring moves again: the moving distortion on the Home ring, the tour ring and the floating ring is back. Reduce motion still holds it still.
Home is calmer: the Settings gear sits at the top-right corner, "100% private" at the top-left, and Home shows the total number of words you have dictated.
Settings has less to read. One switch, "Check for updates automatically", checks at each start and once a day. The Timing section is gone, and its values go back to the defaults. Send feedback moved to a new Help section after Advanced.
